english.title: Driver of vehicle fail to take at least 45 consecutive hours weekly rest period after 6 daily driving periods - EC
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), took a weekly rest period of less than forty five consecutive hours, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TIME PERIOD..), after six daily driving periods ending at **(..SPECIFY DATE AND TIME..) in contravention of Article 8(1) and (6) of the Community Drivers' Hours Regulation

english.notes:
(i) Temporary exceptions for the period from 1st November 2021 ending with 22nd January 2022: see regulation 2 of the Drivers' Hours and Tachographs (Temporary Exceptions) (No. 4) Regulations 2021 (SI 2021/1207) which permits drivers engaged in domestic good transport operations to rely on temporary exceptions where the driver and transport undertaking have reasonable grounds to believe there are exceptional circumstances making compliance with Article 8 of the Drivers' Hours Regulation not reasonably possibly. See regulation 4(2) where a driver may take two reduced weekly rest periods of at least 24 hours followed by two regular weekly rest periods, provided that -(a) any reduction in a weekly rest period shall be compensated for by an equivalent period of rest taken before the end of the third week following the week in question; and
(b) any rest taken as compensation for a reduced weekly rest period -(i) must be taken as an extension to a regular weekly rest period, and
(ii) may be taken divided over two consecutive regular weekly rest periods.Temporary exceptions for the period from 4th October 2021 ending with 31st October 2021: see regulation 2 of the Drivers' Hours and Tachographs (Temporary Exceptions) (No. 3) Regulations 2021 (SI 2021/1106) which permits drivers engaged in domestic good transport operations to rely on temporary exceptions where the driver and transport undertaking have reasonable grounds to believe there are exceptional circumstances making compliance with Article 8 of the Drivers' Hours Regulation not reasonably possibly. See regulation 4(2) where a driver may take two reduced weekly rest periods of at least 24 hours followed by two regular weekly rest periods, provided that -(a) any reduction in a weekly rest period shall be compensated for by an equivalent period of rest taken before the end of the third week following the week in question; and
(b) any rest taken as compensation for a reduced weekly rest period -(i) must be taken as an extension to a regular weekly rest period, and
(ii) may be taken divided over two consecutive regular weekly rest periods.
(ii) See article 6(1) for meaning of 'daily driving period' and article 8(3) for definition of 'weekly rest period' and circumstances in which the weekly rest period may be reduced.
(iii) Where the place of offence is uncertain, section 103(7) provides that offence may be treated as having been committed at the place of driving, the person's place of residence or the principal place of business.
